R. 1118 _______________________________________________________________________ AN ACT To amend title 41, United States Code, to provide best value through the multiple award schedule program, and for other purposes. Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled, SECTION 1. SHORT TITLE. This Act may be cited as the ``Value Over Cost Act of 2026''. SEC. 2. PROVIDING BEST VALUE THROUGH THE MULTIPLE AWARD SCHEDULE PROGRAM. Section 152(3)(B) of title 41, United States Code, is amended by striking ``lowest overall cost alternative'' and inserting ``best value''. Passed the House of Representatives July 21, 2026.
